measures.questionText: Shall bonds of the Central Vermont Career Center School District in an amount not to exceed $54,900,000 be issued for the purpose of expanding technical education in Central Vermont by building on the U-32 campus?
measures.officialStatement: The Central Vermont Career Center School Board proposes to incur bonded indebtedness to expand access to Career and Technical Education in Central Vermont through a multi-campus model by building on the U-32 campus, at an estimated total project cost of $54,900,000. The Vermont State Legislature suspended the School Construction Aid Program in 2007. Therefore, the school district must build 100% of the project at its own cost, without State participation. State funds may not be available when this project would otherwise be eligible to receive State school construction aid. The district is responsible for all costs incurred in connection with any borrowing done in anticipation of State school construction aid.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Replace “Town Administrator” and “Assistant Town Administrator” in the charter’s list of appointed officers with “Town Manager” and “Assistant Town Manager.” The town explains that a manager would have administrative powers set by Vermont law and oversee daily operations and departments, while remaining accountable to the elected Selectboard. The Selectboard would continue setting policy and hiring, evaluating and removing the manager; Town Meeting and voter-approved budgets would continue.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the proposed charter amendment and town manager structure.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize the Central Vermont Career Center School District to borrow up to $54.9 million through bonds to build on the U-32 campus as part of a multi-campus technical education model. The ballot says the district must cover the project’s full cost without state participation because state school construction aid is suspended. State aid might not be available later, and the district is responsible for any costs of borrowing in anticipation of that aid.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize up to $54.9 million in district bonds for the U-32 campus project, with the district responsible for the stated costs.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize the Central Vermont Career Center School District’s School Board to enter a 30-year ground lease with Washington Central Unified Union School District for property at U-32 Middle & High School, 930 Gallison Hill Road, Montpelier. The property would be used to construct, operate and maintain Career Center facilities under lease terms negotiated by the board.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the Career Center board to enter the described 30-year ground lease.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed lease authorization for the Career Center board.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize the Washington Central Unified Union School District’s School Board to enter a 30-year ground lease with Central Vermont Career Center School District for property at U-32 Middle & High School, 930 Gallison Hill Road, Montpelier. The property would be used to construct, operate and maintain Career Center facilities under lease terms negotiated by the board. This is the Washington Central district’s authorization of the lease.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the Washington Central board to enter the described 30-year ground lease.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed lease authorization for the Washington Central board.
